title: inclusive DAO framwork
tagline: This tool add gamification in DAO-member's experience in getting higher levels of DAO's structure to increase their voting power in protocol
description:
This tool add gamification in DAO-member's experience in getting higher levels of DAO's structure to increase their voting power in protocol. 
More higher level users gets (by performing daily recurrent tasks and getting experience points) - more voting power and share in the protocol they have. 
Also, every 5 levels, users gets special NFT that gives them additional perks with protocol
how_its_made:
we use reacts, web3 auth, ens-integration and figma for design. Also use discord for DAO-members communication.
on a contract side we use onen-zeppelin, ERC-721, access -control, and token votes compound bravo, but it still work in progress
we host it in a netlify for now, but then will upload it in IPFS
